name: DCA Manufacturing
old_description: DCA Manufacturing is a leading electronics manufacturing services provider of printed circuit board assemblies and electronic system integration, serving various sectors, including defense, industrial, medical, automotive, energy, and emerging technologies. With a commitment to innovation and excellence, we leverage advanced technologies and a skilled workforce to deliver superior products at every stage that meet our customer’s needs.
about:
DCA Manufacturing, headquartered in Troy, Michigan, was founded in 1981 under the name Debron Industrial Electronics. The company maintains multi-site operations across Michigan and Wisconsin, anchoring its presence in the Midwest's manufacturing corridor.

The company provides end-to-end electronics manufacturing services, including printed circuit board assembly (PCBA), system design and engineering, smart supply chain management, system integration and box build, inspection and testing, and turnkey solutions. With over four decades of experience and a team accumulating 290 years of cumulative technical expertise, DCA operates multiple manufacturing locations in the Midwest, though specific facility sizes and headcount are not disclosed.

DCA serves customers in defense and aerospace, industrial, medical and healthcare, automotive, power and energy, and emerging technology sectors. The company references serving marquee customers across these industries, though specific client names are not disclosed.

DCA emphasizes its financial stability, with over four decades of consistent profitability enabling reinvestment in technology and talent. Its customer-centric culture assigns dedicated program managers to each project, while its integrated manufacturing model eliminates multiple vendors and accelerates time-to-market. The company also highlights its global supply chain network with real-time analytics, customized on-shoring solutions for U.S.-based production, and a geographic advantage in the Midwest's manufacturing corridor.
